```{python}
#| label: fig-layout-merged-diffusion
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Merged diffusion in a series connection of two equally sized MOSFETs (e.g., a cascode): the drain of $M_1$ and the source of $M_2$ share the same diffusion region, which can be kept minimal because it carries no contacts—saving area and junction capacitance."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pyutil import laygen as lg

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 3.4))

lg.rect(ax, 'RX', 0, 0, 6.2, 2.2)
lg.rect(ax, 'PC', 1.9, -0.8, 0.7, 3.8)
lg.rect(ax, 'PC', 3.6, -0.8, 0.7, 3.8)
lg.rect(ax, 'M1', 0.3, 0.1, 1.3, 2.0)
lg.rect(ax, 'M1', 4.6, 0.1, 1.3, 2.0)
# contacts only on the outer S/D, centered in the metal pads
lg.contacts(ax, 0.39, 0.18, 2, 3, pitch=0.72, size=0.4)
lg.contacts(ax, 4.69, 0.18, 2, 3, pitch=0.72, size=0.4)

ax.text(0.95, 2.6, 'S ($M_1$)', fontsize=9, ha='center')
ax.text(2.25, 3.25, 'G$_1$', fontsize=9, ha='center')
ax.text(3.95, 3.25, 'G$_2$', fontsize=9, ha='center')
ax.text(5.25, 2.6, 'D ($M_2$)', fontsize=9, ha='center')
ax.annotate('shared diffusion\n(no contacts)', xy=(3.1, 1.1),
            xytext=(3.1, -1.8), fontsize=8, ha='center',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', lw=0.8))

lg.legend(ax, ['RX', 'PC', 'CA', 'M1'], loc='upper right')
lg.finish(ax, (-0.6, 9.4), (-2.4, 3.8))
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
